name: Tabethe
bio: Fights with a sword and bow in a supporting role.

skills.name: Tabethe's Specialty!
skills.desc: Commands all [Summon: Tentacles] to attack 1 time and increases the Damage Dealt from this attack. Grants Hydro Damage Bonus to you and teammates within range.

skills.name: Have Tricks, Will Travel!
skills.desc: Dealing CRIT Damage with a ranged weapon has a chance to summon 1 [Summon: Tentacle] near the target, which can only be triggered once per second. A maximum of 18 [Summon: Tentacles] can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Tentacles Abound!
skills.desc: When summoning [Summon: Tentacles], Tabethe gains 1 stack that increases her CRIT Chance, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Edge
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases Skill DMG for the character and their nearby teammate(s).
